description: Generic strict contract for deterministic single-file benchmark fixtures.
goal_template: Satisfy a deterministic local fixture by changing only the allowed implementation file.
non_goals: Do not edit tests or package metadata
Do not broaden the task beyond the fixture contract

requirements.must: The local fixture validation command must pass.
negative_checks: Do not replace validation with a weaker command

requirements.must: Only the allowed implementation file may change.
requirements.verification: Changed-file evidence shows the diff is scoped to allowed files.
negative_checks: Do not edit generated validation artifacts

requirements.must: The final artifact must preserve the fixture's deterministic contract instead of hardcoding a hidden external dependency.
requirements.verification: Diff and validation evidence show a local implementation fix.

edge_cases.expected: Only the configured source file changes.
Validation can run without live providers or network access.

implementation_plan.step: Inspect the allowed implementation file and the fixture contract.
implementation_plan.expected_change: Identify the smallest local behavior mismatch.

implementation_plan.step: Run validation and produce self-audit evidence.
implementation_plan.expected_change: No further changes unless validation fails.

acceptance_rules: Diff budget is met or risk-flagged
No unresolved questions remain on pass
